title: The conquest of Peru: Pizarro and the Inca empire
goal: Read how a small Spanish group captured Atahualpa in a divided empire, and use the pluperfect to say what had already happened.

items: Use the pluperfect to say what had already happened before another moment in the past.
Describe what happened at Cajamarca on 16 November 1532.
Say what the Spaniards did to Atahualpa in July 1533.
Explain why many historians say the conquest of Peru did not end at Cajamarca.
Use the key words of the conquest of Peru: ransom, gold, silver, war and throne.
